name.ja: セイコーハウス・和光

representativePoint.method: Area centroid of the frozen projected OSM building footprint; building reference only, not an entrance or walking target.

projection.axes: x east, y north, z height; metres
projection.rounding: Source WGS84 decimals retained; projected points rounded to six decimal metres, without latitude/longitude quantization.
projection.elevationDatum: Authored level ground; no surveyed vertical datum or local grade.

sources.use: Building footprint and selected connected sidewalk centerlines; mapped tags remain source reports.
Operator-published building dimensions, exterior materials and dates, paraphrased as facts. Operator photographs and marketing text are not licensed assets.
Operator identity and postal address; access information does not establish a particular mapped doorway or current sidewalk condition.

dimensions.interpretation: Roof, clock-tower rise, overall tower top and lightning-rod length are distinct operator quantities. The rod is reported on top of the tower. Individual storey heights, tower footprint, bay spacing and cornice depths remain authored.

sourceConflict.resolution: Use operator specifications for vertical authoring. Retain the OSM tag as reported without assigning it to the roof or clock tower.

building.appearanceLimits: Material colour, PBR parameters and the height of each material boundary are authored; the operator identifies floors and finishes without surveyed floor elevations. Hidden sides, roofs and ground-floor access are unverified.

sidewalk.lengthClassification: derived from the selected projected centerline, not a surveyed path length
sidewalk.limits: The selected source chain joins through shared nodes, lies on the Wako side and contains no crossing, steps, indoor or tunnel tags. It does not establish current access, obstruction clearance, pavement width, level changes or step-free suitability. Unselected continuations and adjacent crossings are outside this pack's traversal.

authoredNavigation.endpointTreatment: Finite round caps; no continuation beyond the selected chain.

clearanceReview.method: Projected nonintersecting centerline segments against the complete frozen building footprint.
clearanceReview.classification: derived map geometry clearance; no surveyed kerb or obstruction clearance

spawn.selection: Authored starting position on an internal mapped sidewalk node; not a building entrance.

authoredNavigation.limits: Collision width and level ground are authored around the mapped chain. Keep rendering coverage separate from walkable coverage. No entry to building, station, road or unselected sidewalk is implied.

references.title: Ginza Wako 20241021.jpg
references.author: Supanut Arunoprayote
references.changes: Wikimedia 960px thumbnail, unchanged by this project.
references.visualReview: Lead and art inspected the original on 2026-10-07; art re-reviewed the retained view on 2026-10-19. Rounded corner, clock crown, upper window hierarchy, cornices and recessed lower glazing support original authored geometry.
references.limits: Perspective is not a measurement; ground details are partly occluded, and this is a 2024 view.

references.title: SEIKO HOUSE GINZA 20221216.jpg
references.author: 先従隗始
references.visualReview: Art inspected the downloaded original on 2026-10-19: six central arched upper openings, cornice brackets, paired tower pilasters, grille below the clock and lower stone/glass recesses. Foreground glazing marks across the photograph are excluded from the authored building.
references.limits: Elevated similar corner angle; ground still partly occluded. Hidden sides and entrance access remain unverified. Art owns any retained derivative and its change record.

reuse.dataLicense: OSM-derived geometry: ODbL-1.0; preserve attribution and applicable database obligations.
reuse.referenceUse: Licensed visual references guide original simplified geometry/materials. Photograph pixels are not runtime textures. Credit each retained or used reference with its author, source, license and changes.
